exposure: Iron deficiency anemia at admission for delivery
outcome: Maternal outcomes: packed cells transfusion, early postpartum hemorrhage, preterm delivery
Neonatal outcomes: 5-minute Apgar score < 7, NICU admission, extreme birthweights (macrosomia, large for gestational age)
cohort: 75,660 women with a live-birth singleton fetus in cephalic presentation of any gestational age, excluding those with planned cesarean or chronic/gestational diseases identified with anemia.
finding: Iron deficiency anemia at delivery was associated with an increased risk of cesarean section, adverse maternal outcomes (packed cell transfusion, preterm delivery), and adverse neonatal outcomes (low Apgar score, NICU admission, macrosomia).
birth_weight: Neonatal outcomes included macrosomia and large for gestational age
